Panel B is a schematic diagram, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative MRI images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E histology images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows representative H&E and RNAscope images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope images, not a plot of averaged data.
